responseDefinition.name: project-equivalent 10-to-90 interval
responseDefinition.scope: One common mathematical definition for all ensemble members and model candidates; it is not attributed to the Sharp source.
responseDefinition.fullScaleReference: code 0 to 31 and 31 to 0 use the on-and-off anchor symmetrically
responseDefinition.grayReference: adjacent middle transitions 15 to 16 and 16 to 15 use the gray-scales anchor symmetrically
responseDefinition.uncertainty: The original threshold definition and gray pair are unavailable, so these are compatibility anchors rather than reproduced source waveforms.
